changeSet.author: Anusha
changeSet.sql:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS app.part_file ( file_id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY, part_id BIGINT NOT NULL, company_id BIGINT NOT NULL, file_url VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
CONSTRAINT fk_part_file_part FOREIGN KEY (part_id) REFERENCES app.part(part_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
CONSTRAINT fk_part_file_company FOREIGN KEY (company_id) REFERENCES app.company(company_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
CONSTRAINT uq_part_file UNIQUE (part_id, company_id, file_url) );

rollback.sql: DROP TABLE IF EXISTS app.part_file CASCADE;
